claim_boundary: The lower bound is for black-box access to a unique-marker semantic oracle with no side information. Structured atom families, advice, witness-bearing transcripts, quantum queries, or stronger semantic primitives can change search complexity and must be separately typed.

theorem.atom_universe: N=2^n local semantic atoms with a zero-or-one-marker promise; false-transcript worlds have exactly one marker
theorem.conclusion: small combinatorial dimension does not imply efficient honest search
theorem.post_witness_verification: one ideal semantic query plus n-bit index
